_help: Used to turn the charger operator's fee into an estimated total price, the way a driver pays it in an app like Miio.
total per kWh = (operator fee per kWh + app energy price per kWh + MOBI.E fee / session kWh) x (1 + VAT)
Edit the numbers here when they change; the site picks them up on the next deploy.

sources.mobie_fee_session: MOBI.E / ERSE EGME tariff 2026: EUR 0.1088 per charge
sources.app_energy_kwh: Estimate until confirmed from Miio's Pricing tab
